requirement.normalizedRequirement: Within the ice-strengthened area, all frames shall be effectively attached to all of the supporting structures. A longitudinal frame shall be attached by brackets to all supporting web frames and bulkheads. When a transversal frame terminates at a stringer or deck, a bracket or similar construction must be fitted. When a frame is running through the supporting structure, both sides of the web plate of the frame must be connected to the structure (by direct welding, collar plate or lug). When a bracket is installed, it must have at least the same thickness as the web plate of the frame and the edge must be appropriately stiffened against buckling.
requirement.section: The attachment of frames to supporting structures
requirement.source: Ice Class Regulations and the Application Thereof
requirement.sourceText: Within the ice-strengthened area, all frames shall be effectively attached to all of the supporting structures. A longitudinal frame shall be attached by brackets to all supporting web frames and bulkheads. When a transversal frame terminates at a stringer or deck, a bracket or similar construction must be fitted. When a frame is running through the supporting structure, both sides of the web plate of the frame must be connected to the structure (by direct welding, collar plate or lug). When a bracket is installed, it must have at least the same thickness as the web plate of the frame and the edge must be appropriately stiffened against buckling.
